title: Knowledge Source Manifest
description: 04-knowledge-platform.md §4.2 — one row per source document that fed a Knowledge Package. Produced by packages/knowledge-packager from the indexing artifacts of one AssetVersion (data/indexes/{id}/parents.json). Field names are verbatim from §4.2. A value of '미기재' (NOT_RECORDED) means the field is not derivable from data the pipeline actually captured today — never a fabricated value (see packages/knowledge-packager/src/knowledge_packager/source_manifest.py).

knowledge_asset_version_id.description: The Knowledge AssetVersion id these documents were indexed under — matches data/indexes/{id}/

relative_source_path.description: Relative path — no path traversal. For legacy (pre-D-053) index dirs this may be a filename-only best-effort value, never a fabricated directory structure.

source_hash.description: sha256 of the original source file, computed only when that file still resolves on the build host filesystem at package-build time; otherwise 미기재

owner.description: Populated from the Knowledge Asset Manifest's owner field when the caller supplies one to `package-knowledge build --asset-manifest`; otherwise 미기재

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date when populated; note 'format' is annotation-only (not enforced) under this repo's Draft202012Validator(schema) usage — see ai_asset_schemas.validator.validate

parser_identity.description: Loader/parser identity — not tracked anywhere in the current indexing pipeline output, so always 미기재 today (documented limitation, not silently dropped)
